moments.text: Infrared view over clouds: a small bright object at the head of a thin straight bright trail sits just above the crosshair, then slides out to the upper left.
A small bright dot drifts from the upper left across the top of the view to the upper right, above a broad bright cloud streak.
The picture flashes white for under a second, then returns darker and grainier over dark cloud.
A small bright dot enters at the top, under a bright cloud band, and drifts down toward the right of the crosshair.
The display turns green and blurry, breaks into blocky lines, then goes black for a moment.
A grey, blocky picture: the small bright dot sits just above the crosshair, then the view breaks up and it is lost.
A new view to the end: a flat layer of cloud tops below darker cloud bands, crosshair centred, no object visible.

notes: Official description says 00:19-00:23 'No content', but a cloud-deck view is shown there.
